interview.name: Oren
interview.answer: It’s now at the community center on Sunday.

reflections: Oren is dependable but needs reminders and context to follow through.
Quinn and Vik are organizing concrete community repair and donation tasks, and they communicate roles clearly.
Oren responds well to explicit, specific coordination and is willing to help when asked directly.
Oren is consistently willing to help and follows through on commitments when reminded.
The others rely on Oren for practical support with setup and sorting tasks.
Simple, specific reminders help keep Oren aligned with the event plans.
Oren is consistently dependable and offers concrete help, especially for Saturday morning repair-drive tasks.
The group coordination is organized around a clear time and place, with people confirming attendance and bringing tools or materials.
Cleo and Sam seem to be the main organizers, while Oren is a responsive volunteer who adapts to whatever task is needed.
Oren is a reliable, hands-on helper who repeatedly confirms plans and offers practical support for the repair work.
The group is coordinating a small repair drive around Saturday at 10 by the garage, with shared expectations about tools and supplies.
Nell is newly looped in and still needs context, while Uli is the main organizer keeping everyone aligned.
Oren is consistently willing to help coordinate the repair drive and show up at the agreed time.
Nell and Mina are seeking concrete details and may need clearer communication about the event's logistics.
Gus seems to have the most up-to-date information about the repair drive, including the location change and supplies.

events.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help, I just need a little reminder of what we’re fixing and when to show up.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Quinn: We’re fixing up the community shed and a few loose fence panels this Saturday morning. Come by around 10 and I’ll point you to the tools.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Oren: Got it — community shed and fence panels this Saturday around 10. I’ll be there, and if I forget, I’ll ask you again!
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m happy to help, if you still need a hand with it.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren — I do still need a hand. I’m planning to sort the donations and set up the table later today.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Oren: Sure thing — I can help sort the donations and set up the table later today.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive — thanks for the reminder. I’ll come by Saturday around 10 and help with the shed and fence panels.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Sam: Thanks, Oren — that’ll be a big help. I’ll sort the donations and keep the list ready for Saturday.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Oren: Great, Sam — I’ll be there at 10 on Saturday and I’m glad to help. Just point me to the tools when I arrive.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I can help sort the donations and set up the table Saturday around 10.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Cleo: That’s perfect, Oren — thank you. Sorting and setting up the table Saturday at 10 will help a lot.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Oren: You bet, Cleo — I’ll be there Saturday at 10 and ready to help.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I can come by Saturday around 10 and help sort things out.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Pia: That works for me — Saturday at 10 by your garage is good. I’ll bring the tools I have and keep an eye out if anything changes.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Oren: Great, I’ll be there by the garage at 10 on Saturday. Thanks for bringing the tools — I’ll help sort everything out.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’ll come by Saturday around 10 and help with the shed and fence panels.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Leo: Great, Saturday at 10 works for me. What should I bring for the shed and fence panels?
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Oren: Mostly just gloves and a drill if you’ve got one — and maybe a tape measure. If I remember anything else, I’ll let you know.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Uli: Yes, Saturday at 10 by my garage is still the plan. Thank you for helping out, Oren.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Oren: Oh, right — Saturday at 10 by the garage. I’ll be there and help sort things out.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. I appreciate you being there Saturday at 10 by the garage.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive?
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I can come by Saturday around 10 and help sort things out.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Nell: Saturday around 10 sounds good—do you know if there’s anything I should bring?
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Mina: I’m trying to find the location for the repair drive. Do you know where it’s being held?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m not sure of the exact spot, but if you tell me where to go, I can be there Saturday around 10 to help sort things out.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Mina: Thanks, Oren. If you hear the location, please let me know — do you know who’s organizing it?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Gus: Yep, it’s at the community center on Sunday now. If you need a tool for the repair drive, you can borrow one from me.
events.speaker: Gus

prov.value: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Oren: Oh, right — Sunday at the community center. Thanks, Gus; I can come by and help sort things out, and I may take you up on borrowing a tool.
events.speaker: Oren
